topics.label: Is there any work?

do.journal: Aldous Penhallow, Reeve of Brindle, wants his signet ring back. Jory Quickfingers stole it and fled into the Hollow Barrow, south of town. Reward promised.

topics.say: Work? Oh, thank the Lantern. My signet ring, my seal of office, has been stolen. Jory Quickfingers, a thief of no particular talent. He fled south into the Hollow Barrow three nights ago and hasn't come out. Fetch me that ring and I will pay you a hundred and fifty gold. And I'll be very, very grateful, which is worth at least another ten.

topics.label: About your signet...
topics.say: The barrow is south, out of the gate and down the road. Jory went in with a candle and no sense. Bring me the ring. Please. I've had to sign everything with my thumb.

topics.label: Return the signet

do.journal: Returned the signet to the Reeve. He paid 150 gold and wept a little. Brindle owes you one.

do.note: Quest complete: The Reeve's Signet. You receive 150 gold.

topics.say: My ring! My beautiful, official ring! And poor Jory... well, he did steal it. Here: a hundred and fifty gold, as promised. Brindle is in your debt. I shall write you a letter of thanks. With my seal on it. Because I can, now.

topics.label: Buy a healing draught (15 gold)
topics.poor: That's more gold than you've got, love. I don't do tabs.
topics.say: There you go. Don't drink it all at once. Actually, do, that's how it works.

topics.label: Rent a room for the night (10 gold)
topics.poor: Ten gold for a bed. Come back when you can afford sleeping.

do.note: You sleep for eight hours in a bed that only slightly smells of goose.

topics.label: Buy a healing draught (12 gold)
topics.poor: That's more gold than you've got, love. I don't do tabs.
topics.say: One healing draught! Shake well. Do not shake the person drinking it.

topics.label: Buy a whetstone (40 gold)
topics.poor: Forty gold, friend. I can see your purse from here, and it is not forty gold.
topics.say: A fine whetstone. Give that blade a proper edge. Your sword will thank you. Swords don't talk, mind, but you'll know.

topics.label: Ask for a blessing (5 gold)
topics.poor: Five gold, child. The Lantern does not burn on goodwill alone. It burns on oil, which costs money.
topics.say: Be warm and be lit. There. Your wounds are mended, and your soul is marginally tidier.

topics.label: What's down the south road?
topics.say: The barrow? Out the south gate, follow the road till the trees close in. Big grassy lump, stone door, smells like a cellar that's given up. Rats, mostly. And worse, further down.

topics.label: Is there any work?
topics.say: Work? Go and see the Reeve. He has been asking everyone, even the ducks.

places.prompt: Where are you trying to get to?
